name: npl-enhanced-content
description: NPL-enhanced content — Unicode-block semantic markup rendered by Lit web components. Zero React.
'.' points at dist/npl.js, an IIFE global script with no ESM/CJS exports. 'type: module' advertises an ESM package; a bundler resolving '.' via import gets a script it cannot import from. Known conflict, tracked as ROADMAP.md debt D9 — do not import '.' from JS; use it only via <script> tag until M5 resolves the entry format.
